name: Band Hunting Dogs

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.text: Reduces the morale of nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Spear Wall
abilities.text: The unit moves into close wall formation.

abilities.name: Barbarian Testudo
abilities.text: The troops of this unit raise their shields above their heads in a static defensive formation.

abilities.name: Square
abilities.text: The unit moves into a close square formation. Note that it cannot move whilst this ability is active.

attributes.name: Expert Charge Defence
attributes.text: This unit’s melee attack and damage are increased against charging enemies.

attributes.name: Resistant to Fatigue
attributes.text: Fatigue has less of an effect on this unit.

attributes.name: Guerrilla Deployment
attributes.text: This unit can deploy outside of the deployment zone.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

short: Dogs have always been useful for guard, patrol and scout work. With skilled handlers they can also be used effectively on the battlefield. Attack dogs were specifically bred and trained to ignore the noise and chaos of combat. Taught to attack on command, they were starved a little to ensure aggression before being unleashed upon enemy formations as a savage wave. Faced with a pack of foaming, hungry dogs many men naturally broke or faltered, opening gaps in a battle line that could then be exploited by melee troops.
